Hello morning crew,
The cargo lead raised some notes on hand-off notes mid-morning, and I wanted to pass it on

Please keep the animal files tight and legible from check-in through ramp release. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey. If a traveler arrives concerned about a carrier, a feeding note, or a transfer detail, slow the process and confirm the record before anything moves forward. Clear guidance must go out before departure, and any uncertainty should be raised to the supervisor without delay.

<<FACT F031>> Make sure the record is read back in full during the hand-off so the receiving team has the same information we do. If there is any mismatch between the booking notes and the crate label, stop and correct it at once. We are not pushing through rough handovers, and we are not allowing assumptions to replace written instructions. The department coordinates care from booking through pickup, so every step must stay aligned and calm. If a passenger shows concern, listen carefully, note the issue, and respond with the approved process only.

Keep the desk orderly, the language brief, and the hand-off clean. Any exception should be escalated in the moment, not saved for later. Thanks for staying sharp and consistent throughout the shift.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
